content.comment_body: Hello, I currently have an installation with a [product_name] display module and need to upgrade the [product_name] controller. Is the newest [version_no] series still compatible with my existing [product_name] display?

analysis.insight_summary: The user is asking about compatibility between a [product_name] display and the latest [version_no] controller. This compatibility concern is common during upgrades, and addressing it is important for ensuring smooth operation after updates.
